label: Проверить и опубликовать MCP resource claim consumer
description: Перенести scoped commit 74d4cf6c только по двум owned paths на актуальный main без затрагивания чужих путей. Проверить NativeServer MCP wire resource.claim и resource.release совместно с offline CLI на одном временном resource; один победитель, чужой release rejected, reopen readback. Scoped publish и receipt.
acceptance: Реальные NativeServer MCP tools/call и offline CLI используют один временный authority: ровно один claim winner, release чужого principal отклонён, restart/reopen readback подтверждает owner; owned commit опубликован на main.

progress_events.note: Астра подтверждает продолжение того же исполнителя: scoped перенос на актуальный main и wire proof, без ожидания общего launcher.

changes.result: Published to origin/main: commit 0fdd84c71332321fc8c652efcc7fc961aaa451c2 (parent ffb714b5), three scoped paths only: crates/herder/src/application/workspace.rs, crates/herder/src/lib.rs (single authorized pub mod workspace line), crates/herder/tests/workspace_mcp_wire.rs. Wire evidence: `cargo test --test workspace_mcp_wire` PASS 1/1; starts NativeServer::with_application and sends JSON-RPC tools/call resource.claim, offline CLI claim on identical temp file authority gets busy (MCP sole winner), separate NativeServer Bob resource.release gets MCP isError=true, reopened StorageAuthority read_by_claim_id confirms alice, offline CLI status=owned. Focused source tests: `cargo test application::workspace::tests --lib` PASS 2/2 including concurrent MCP adapter/CLI race exactly one winner, wrong-owner release, missing ACL rejection and reopen readback. Push accepted fast-forward ffb714b5..0fdd84c7; subsequent fetch confirms origin/main equals published commit. No Cargo/schema/launcher changes.
